name: Hooded Hydra
oracle_text:
This creature enters with X +1/+1 counters on it.
When this creature dies, create a 1/1 green Snake creature token for each +1/+1 counter on it.
Morph {3}{G}{G}
As this creature is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters on it.
blocked_sentences: As this creature is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters on it.

needs.what: a self replacement applied as this permanent is turned face up, by any means (special action or a turn_face_up effect), that puts N counters of a kind on it before turned_face_up fires -- 'As this creature is turned face up, put five +1/+1 counters on it' (708.8, 702.37); a counted generalisation of what primitives.turn_face_up's megamorph flag does for one counter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: morph_counter is a boolean for one +1/+1 counter and only applies when the megamorph cost is paid; a turned_face_up trigger with add_counters uses the stack, so the Hydra is a 0/0 face up with the trigger pending and dies to 704.5f before it resolves, and can be responded to. self_enters_with_counters is the X-counters-on-entry line, already expressible. The Snake token the dies trigger names, snake_1_1_g, is now in the pool
